item13.every_b: Unchanged engine: Abel inversion to radial differential identities, case domains and velocity-square reductions.
item13.component_calculus: Unchanged engine: spherical-coordinate Jacobian and divergence on coordinate d3x.
item13.profiles: Unchanged engine: general live radial functions, derivatives, integrals and bound ray-domain sets.

bindings.construction: Computed asymptotic bulk sound-speed square; historical uniform anchor only.

witness_profiles: Fixed-coefficient functions only for comparison tests; no order-counting restriction. No engine object or shared profile family is changed.

evaluation_methods.change: Retained arithmetic reduction, alpha-renamed bound variables, inert zero integrals and exact held predicates. A proved zero is never overridden.

Retained six radial functions, rational point bank and complete set-element candidate enumeration. Derivatives/Subs resolved before enclosing arithmetic rebuild; nonrational relations held until explicitly decided.

Replaced general symbolic integration that stalled full8. Fraction arithmetic, outward 80-bit dyadic rounding; square roots via integer square-root bounds, pi via Machin alternating-series bound, log via range reduction and bounded atanh-series tail. No floating-point value witness.

128 whole-panel interval-Horner bounds, exact reciprocal tail transformation with Jacobian. Arithmetic step budget 50000, degree limit32, coefficient bits4096, integer power64, polynomial power16. Unsupported/unresolved endpoints, poles, convergence or budgets are explicit evaluation failures, never zero/change.

Restrict reduction to rational linear/quadratic numerator/denominator, coefficient bits128. Final fix excludes denominator poles, preserving domains after cancellation; other conditions retain element membership search.

Final candidate checks at most512 native tree nodes and32 set nodes before profile/point transformation. Exceeding the budget records unresolved for every candidate. Failed set evaluation retains original-set element enumeration. No job deadline.
Final candidate explicitly certifies every element, recursively for tuples; undefined/unsupported elements record SET_ELEMENT failure. Element enclosures contribute to witness arithmetic metadata.

Nonexact witnesses carry PRECISION_BITS, both individual error bounds, ERROR_BOUND_BOTH_EVALUATIONS and EVALUATION_ENCLOSURES; separation must exceed the combined bound. Unresolved reasons counted under EVALUATION_UNRESOLVED. Agreement proves nothing.
Unchanged construction/configuration; same comparison rule applies to differences and method residuals. Executed in full9.

checks19 exposed NaN ordering in the fallback element enumeration. Undefined NaN candidates are retained, sorted structurally after ordinary candidates, and reported by definedness evaluation. checks20 and full9 consume this fix.

witness_search_configuration.joint_assignments: Six deterministic rotations across live functions and six point rotations filtered by symbol assumptions; no assignments to bound variables.
witness_search_configuration.set_elements: Scalar bank, Cartesian tuple banks at each required arity, explicit finite-set entries and interval endpoints/midpoints; undefined entries are visited and reported unresolved.
